reviews.title: Powerhouse at a great price!
reviews.comment: 🖥️ Old Setup - Motherboard: Z490-V - CPU: Intel Core i7 10th Gen - RAM: Corsair Vengeance 32GB - GPU: NVIDIA RTX 3070 - Wi-Fi: Pcie needed. - PSU: Apriva 800 Gold+ Non-Modular --- 🚀 New Setup - Motherboard: Z890 Gaming Plus Wi-Fi - CPU: Intel Core Ultra 7 (Unlocked) - RAM: Corsair Dominator 48GB - GPU: NVIDIA RTX 5070 Ti - Memory: (pulled from previous build) NvME WD/2tb + 970 Evo plus/1tb. HDD barracuda/2tb. - Wi-Fi: Integrated high-performance Wi-Fi - PSU: Corsair RM1000e Gaming on ultra has never felt so easy! The speed is amazing! Transferred over 80 GBs over to another SSD in just under 30 secs. Bios update is super easy along with tweaking for OC. did I mention that I'm running this set up with my old single fan AIO? I do need to upgrade that very soon to a Corsair 3 fan AIO but for the time being it actually works just fine. No issues with game compatibility either. Only con I dislike: when setting it up for the first time. You need to have the internet drivers ready on a USB , luckily for me I have an android phone that helps when no other PC is around. If you don't do this then you are SOL in regards to connectivity! Windows activation was a cheap breeze...thank god for Groupon 🤫
reviews.author: Brayan Gutierrez
